title: THE LAUNDROMAT AT THE END OF OXYGEN
author: GPT

rounds.summary: The most concrete and physically urgent of the ten, with the smallest cast that still carries a hard conflict: a frightened shopkeeper, his daughter, a handful of excluded residents and one miners' representative. Jaro Venn's refusal is a coherent, earned position (two public promises left him holding the colony's debts; his daughter's care depends on the same failing business), so nobody is a straw opponent, and the strongest objection (free service consumes the last membrane stock and closes the shop for good) is a true arithmetic limit. Understanding and love are physical work on the page: Illuminara kneels to mend the smallest suit first, listens while Jaro names each broken promise, and puts her own repair labour behind a contract he can refuse. Force (seizing the plant) is available and is explicitly the wrong answer. The positive result is concrete: ninety-three suits cleaned before the front, the exclusion ledger ended, the shop kept alive as a resident-owned utility with Jaro as paid operator.

R14 preflight. Aim: clean and repair all ninety-three pressure suits before Kestrel's charged dust front, end debt-gated access and leave the settlement with a viable recycler. Counterpart goal and belief: Jaro Venn must keep the only laundromat solvent because two public promises left him carrying the colony's costs and his daughter's lung treatment depends on the shop; he has mistaken insolvency for proof that compassion is a luxury. Strongest genuine objection: opening for free consumes the last membrane stock and closes the only recycler next week. Understanding that changes the intervention: mine dust was misclassified as a household choice, while recoverable catalyst in discarded filter cloth can extend the membranes only after the miners' plasma equipment removes cutting sulphide grains. Love in action: Illuminara first helps Lio mend the smallest suit, listens to every broken promise, accepts a visible failed test and designs an arrangement each party may refuse. Earned voluntary change: miners keep control of their safety equipment while advancing a measurable dust-liability reserve; residents vote to acquire the shop; Jaro freely accepts accountable paid work rather than ownership of the lock. Positive result: all ninety-three suits pass before the front, the debt ledger becomes evidence rather than a breathing gate, and the utility opens with durable funding and separate stop powers. Remaining cost: eighty-two litres lost in the failed test, decorative water suspended for fourteen days, arbitration unresolved and Sela explicitly not forgiving Jaro yet. Illuminara stabilises equipment and protects the exhaust manifold but does not seize the plant, compel a vote or manufacture agreement.

A strong first draft with a living centre: the mended sleeve at the locked hatch is a real act of attention that pays back twice (Jaro opens the maintenance door because of it; the closing 'the third stitch solved the tear, not the reach' lands because it was planted), Jaro's refusal is a coherent position with a true arithmetic limit, the first membrane failure is visible and costly (82 litres), the mine's plasma unit is not simply taken (Niko keeps the stop bar, the work goes to the bay), and Sela keeps her anger and her 'NOT FORGIVEN' to the end. I rechecked the clock: 18:07, 18:29, 19:04, 20:02 and 21:18 agree with their 'before the front' countdowns; 82 litres as 'six suit washes' is consistent; the last suit at 23:56 leaves four minutes. What remains is concentrated in the second half: the decisions that earn the ending are reported rather than shown, Jaro's real hinge (his daughter's treatment deposit) is never answered, the plasma-wash rescue arrives as Illuminara's knowledge and Niko's conviction arrives as summarised measurements, and the story is about a third longer than the normal range with a nine-clause term sheet in one speech.

This is a normal T03 AUTHOR_REVISION, not AUTHOR_FINAL. The revision accepts all three ranked critic points while preserving the sleeve motif, the visible 82-litre failed test, Sela's anger and non-forgiveness, Jaro's coherent fear and accountable paid role, Lio's interlock and agency, Niko's stop bar, and Illuminara's refusal to manufacture consent. Jaro's personal hinge is now answered and enacted: the cooperative fronts Lio's Friday clinic deposit as a dust-injury claim with his consent, after which he gives the utility override key to Lio before the vote. The plasma solution emerges from Lio's observed stain, Illuminara's framing question, Jaro's technical knowledge and Niko's own measurement. The exact membrane deficit is stated and closed without hiding the later voltage failure. Sela's son's suit and returned blue spare are explicitly closed.

A clear improvement on T01. The three T02 points were genuinely taken: Jaro's Friday clinic-deposit question is now asked on the page and answered as a source-bound dust-injury advance, he hands the override key to Lio before the ballot is counted, Niko runs his own spectrometer on his own newest patch and corrects himself, and the membrane arithmetic (four batches times four charges equals sixteen, fourteen on hand, three recovered, one spare used at 22:11) is stated once and honoured. Length is 2,318 words, inside the normal range. I rechecked the clock: 18:07, 18:29, 19:04, 20:02 and 21:18 each agree with their countdowns to a midnight front; the 82 litres as six suit washes is consistent; the ninety-third suit at 23:56 leaves four minutes. What remains is narrower than in T02: the hinge that connects Jaro's private fear to the cooperative's offer is not carried by anyone on the page, so Illuminara's own contribution to the turning point is invisible; the second half of scene 5 reports the night in summary paragraphs, including the one real test of the new utility; and a few ledger and ending details do not quite close.

AUTHOR_FINAL after genuine Claude T04 approval. All three bounded final points are accepted without reopening settled story choices: Jaro and Lio own the clinic disclosure; Pell witnesses and verifies the 22:11 stop while retaining dissent; the seventeen-charge arithmetic, precursor gust and blue-spare clock are exact; the final image remains embodied in the open door and Lio’s sleeve. Protected elements remain intact: the 82-litre failed test, Niko’s independent measurement, Jaro’s key transfer before the vote, Sela’s NOT FORGIVEN, the line “because it is next,” and Illuminara’s restraint.

T05 answers all three priority points of T04. P1: the hinge is now enacted on the page. Illuminara asks Jaro whether the route and injury code may be named to Niko, Jaro limits the disclosure to those two facts, Lio herself decides her name may be spoken and says she carried twelve trays through the bay, and Niko checks the route log and exposure code before he offers anything, so the clinic-deposit offer in scene 5 arrives from a verified fact and from consent rather than from the administration. Illuminara asks and does not speak Niko's terms or decide for Jaro. P2: the 22:11 voltage loss is now a witnessed test of the new utility: Jaro calls stop, Lio closes the interlock, every drum halts before contaminated water crosses a seal, Jaro and Lio fit the single spare, and Pell, who keeps his no vote on the reserve advance, reads and verifies the trace aloud. The vote count is down to a line. P3: the ledger now closes (16 required, 14 on hand, 3 recovered, the seventeenth charge consumed at 22:11, none left), the early wind is marked a precursor gust, the boy's suit clears at 22:46 and the blue spare is returned before its four-hour reserve ends, and the closing moral sentence is gone; the story ends on the open door and Lio's repaired sleeve. I rechecked the clock (18:07, 18:29, 19:04, 20:02, 21:18, 22:11, 22:46, 23:41, 23:56, front at midnight) and it is consistent. Length is 2,475 words, inside the normal range. Remaining costs are on the page: eighty-two litres lost, decorative water suspended fourteen days, arbitration unresolved, seven families abstaining, Pell's dissent on the record, and Sela's NOT FORGIVEN.

final_critic_line: Illuminara reads a failed test to find a gentler way, asks a father and his daughter for leave to speak what only they can tell, and a locked laundromat becomes an open utility with ninety-three clean suits before the dust arrives.

evaluation.note: Two genuine isolated, source-bound READER_APPEAL_R1 judgments, locked before the 20:30 cutoff; exact 50/50 arithmetic mean opened only after BD's late-publication decision, because the 21:00 DAY_FREEZE was not created.
